lines.3: 「There are reasons we want you even after all that.」
lines.4: But I couldn't exactly tell her the student council president was after her body--or rather, her chest.
lines.5: Time to hit her with a full-on rush.
lines.6: 「Listen. The way you state your opinion clearly is admirable. You're a Japanese person who can say no.」
lines.7: 「That's the kind of talent the student council wants. You stand out even among the first-years.」
lines.8: 「And that's not all. You're beautiful, aren't you?」
lines.9: 「You're tall, slender, and striking. The student council appears in the school brochures, you know.」
lines.10: 「This may sound unpleasant, but someone like you joining would make us look better.」
lines.11: 「And you seem smart. Your grades aren't bad, right? That means you meet the intellectual requirements too.」
lines.12: A lethal barrage of praise. How about that?
lines.13: 「...Hmm. I understand the circumstances a little better now.」
lines.15: She waved me away with her hand.
lines.20: 「For what it is worth, I was turning you down politely.」
lines.22: 「If you were some sweaty, reeking man, I would have crushed you for being unsightly.」
lines.23: With that, Yashi turned back toward the sea.
lines.24: This was brutal. There wasn't the slightest opening to win her over.
